stages.action: Astronaut sitting in neutral posture. Outer containment box is closed.
stages.audio_instruction: System initialized. Please open the box.

stages.action: Astronaut leans forward, grasps box flaps and opens the lid to ~70° elevation.
stages.audio_instruction: Box opened. Next step: Please take out the object.

stages.action: Astronaut reaches inside, establishes dual-hand grasp on inner box, and extracts it outside the container boundary.
stages.audio_instruction: Object extracted. Next step: Please return the object into the box.
stages.safety_gate: Debounced >= 12 frames. Premature box closure gated with ERROR_SKIP alert.

stages.action: Astronaut guides extracted object back inside the container between foam cushions while lid remains elevated.
stages.audio_instruction: Object returned. Next step: Please close the box.
stages.safety_gate: Debounced >= 12 frames with all items inside container.

stages.action: Astronaut folds box flaps down to closed position (lid angle < 20°).
stages.safety_gate: Debounced >= 12 frames. Procedure verified and mission log committed.
